note: Twelve engineering-history questions over the APF repository. Each requires at least one of temporal, relationship, or provenance reasoning. Gold evidence is declared as repository objects and was frozen before any context was constructed or scored.

cases.question: Which BENCH-0004 execution first produced a negative result for CLM-0004, and what did the following round conclude?
What did the recorded session state say immediately after the claim cold review, and how did that differ from the state recorded before it?
Which claim was split into narrower mechanism claims, what evidence triggered the split, and which document had required that decomposition?
Which document defines hypothesis H07, and was that document present in the repository at the time the E2 handoff instructed assessing H07?
What was corrected in the BENCH-0004-E2 fixture lock between its first and second version, and what was the stated reason?
Which commit introduced the falsification benchmark protocol, and which other research document was committed in the same session?
Which retrieval condition showed no advantage at document-recall level but did show an advantage at cross-document chain-coverage level?
What is the governance path from a research finding to an architecture candidate, and where in that path is the benchmark execution gate?
Which benchmark adjudicates CLM-0004, and which hypotheses does that same benchmark explicitly not adjudicate?
What evidence limitation prevents CLM-0004a, CLM-0004b and CLM-0004c from advancing to SUPPORTED?
Which research material is confirmed as preserved in the repository, and which material still requires durable asset records before it counts as evidence?
What changed in the claim inventory between its first committed version and its current state, and what caused that change?
